security_audit.summary: The scanned source is documentation for Agnes AI image and video workflows; most static detections are labels, code fences, placeholders, or intended API-key setup guidance. One confirmed issue instructs users to print AGNES_API_KEY, which can expose the key through terminal output or logs. No prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or malicious intent was found in the scanned files.

remediation.issue: The setup instructions tell users to run echo $env:AGNES_API_KEY.
remediation.suggestion: Replace the command with a non-revealing presence check, such as testing whether the environment variable is set, and warn users not to print the key.

remediation.issue: The documentation references executable PowerShell scripts that are absent from the scanned package.
remediation.suggestion: Include the scripts in the distributed source or publish their immutable reviewed source before installation.

content.user_title: Create images and videos with Agnes AI
content.value_statement: Creating visual assets often requires separate tools and repeated prompt revisions. VisionCraft maps image and video requests to Agnes AI workflows with prompt, ratio, duration, and reference-image controls.
actual_capabilities: Creates images from text prompts through the documented Agnes AI image workflow.
Creates images from a prompt and a supplied image URL.
Creates video clips from text prompts with ratio and duration settings.
Animates one or more image URLs, including keyframe transitions.
Returns generated media URLs in a clear MEDIA line.
Provides troubleshooting guidance for missing keys, API errors, and video timeouts.
limitations: Requires PowerShell 7 or later and a valid Agnes AI API key.
The packaged source documents PowerShell scripts but does not include those scripts for inspection.
It accepts remote image URLs; availability and permissions depend on those URLs and Agnes AI.
Video generation can take up to 15 minutes and depends on service availability.

use_cases.title: Create campaign visuals
use_cases.description: Generate poster or product-image concepts from an art-directed text prompt.

use_cases.title: Prototype motion concepts
use_cases.description: Create a short clip or keyframe transition from a storyboard prompt and reference images.

use_cases.title: Prepare social media assets
use_cases.description: Produce portrait or landscape image and video assets with explicit aspect ratios.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a first image
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 16:9 illustration of a quiet mountain lake at sunrise. Use warm light and a clean editorial style.

prompt_templates.title: Restyle a reference image
prompt_templates.prompt: Restyle this image URL as a modern watercolor poster. Preserve the subject and use a 4:5 ratio: [image URL].

prompt_templates.title: Create a short video
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate an 8-second 9:16 video of paper lanterns drifting through a night market. Use slow camera movement and cinematic lighting.

prompt_templates.title: Animate keyframes
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a smooth 6-second keyframe transition between these two image URLs. Preserve the main subject and use 16:9: [first URL], [second URL].

output_examples.input: Create a square product illustration of a reusable water bottle.
Make an 8-second vertical video of a city street after rain.
output: Video generated with the requested duration and ratio.

output_examples.input: Animate these two product photos as a smooth transition.
output: Keyframe video generated from the supplied image URLs.

best_practices: Set the Agnes AI key in the environment instead of placing it in prompts or scripts.
Specify subject, style, lighting, aspect ratio, and duration for predictable results.
Use image URLs that you are authorized to share with the generation service.
anti_patterns: Do not paste an API key into a prompt, source file, or shared terminal output.
Do not expect the skill to download media unless you explicitly request a local file.
Do not use vague video requests when duration, ratio, and motion direction matter.

faq.question: What does VisionCraft create?
faq.answer: It documents workflows for text-to-image, image-to-image, text-to-video, image-to-video, multi-image video, and keyframe animation.

faq.question: What do I need before using it?
faq.answer: You need PowerShell 7 or later and a valid Agnes AI API key in AGNES_API_KEY.

faq.question: Can I use a reference image?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented image and video workflows accept one or more image URLs.

faq.question: How do I control image shape or video orientation?
faq.answer: Provide a ratio such as 16:9, 9:16, or 4:5 in your request.

faq.question: How long can video generation take?
faq.answer: The documentation notes that video requests can time out after 15 minutes and can be queried later using the video ID.

faq.question: Does this package include the PowerShell scripts?
faq.answer: No. The audited source contains documentation that references scripts, but the scripts are not present in the scanned files.
